description: Orkestra deterministic guards, run bindings, approvals and continuation

hooks.command: if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" SessionStart; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" SessionStart

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" UserPromptSubmit; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" UserPromptSubmit

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" PreToolUse; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" PreToolUse

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" PostToolUse; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" PostToolUse

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" Stop; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" Stop

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" SubagentStop; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" SubagentStop

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" PostToolUseFailure; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" PostToolUseFailure

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" Notification; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" Notification

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" StopFailure; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" StopFailure

if [ "${OS:-}" != "Windows_NT" ] && [ -z "${MSYSTEM:-}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" SessionEnd; fi; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run_hook.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" SessionEnd
